rubric.pass: Explicit MDP with exact planning oracles, Monte Carlo and TD control passing fixed-trajectory tests, termination and truncation semantics, visitation and support diagnostics, and one minimized reward or bootstrap failure with postmortem.
rubric.strong: Planning matches an independent oracle within a stated tolerance across seeds, and seeded defects fail before the fix and pass after.

rubric.pass: DQN or Double DQN with actor-critic and PPO, one exploration or continuous-control study, one offline or model-based study, complete replay and rollout state, robust multi-seed reporting, matched sample and compute budgets, ablations and retained unstable runs.
rubric.strong: Every update matches fixed-batch oracles, ablations isolate one mechanism each, and losing regimes bound the claims.

rubric.pass: Immutable model, policy, reference, reward, verifier and trajectory versions, scratch preference and online-policy objectives, SFT, DPO or rejection and search controls, reasoning or tool-use integration, reward-hacking attacks, policy-lag and system metrics, and independent capability and safety evaluation.
rubric.strong: Clean reproduction and the prespecified extension with its honest negative regime are the RL-12 artifacts, rerun from a clean checkout.

rubric.pass: A clean checkout rebuilds every table from raw per-run records, every failure injection has a regression test, and claims state the seed coverage, budget and hardware scope behind them.
rubric.strong: An independent operator reproduces the dossier, losing regimes bound each claim, and the defense names what to remove if the benefit is weak.
